summary: ClipBucket V5: a self-hosted video/photo sharing platform (YouTube/Netflix-style clone) in PHP+MySQL. Users upload videos and photos, organize them into collections and playlists, comment/rate/favorite/subscribe/friend, send private messages; admins manage members, videos, photos, ads, email templates, tags/categories, flagged items and site settings. Schema read from cb_install/sql/structure.sql; operations mined from includes/classes/*.class.php and actions/*.php + admin_area.

_no_edges.why: public ad-serving read; getAd() has no auth plug and no policy call (ads.class.php:163) - served to anonymous page visitors
internal mail-send helper (email_template.class.php:787); called from many ops, itself has no route, no pre-checks beyond config('disable_email'), dispatches via email_histo

_drops: video_addtocollection (duplicate of collection_add_item — same HTTP endpoint add_to_collection.php; both insert into CollectionItem)
